author: hku-mip
description:
This is a CBCT projection dataset. 
It consists of CBCT projection data of brain, head and neck, lungs, prostate, and pancreas cases. 
The projection data were acquired using 3 CBCT systems (XVI Elekta, Varian Truebeam, and IBA Toshiba).
You can find Python scripts to download, read, and visualize the data in the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/MedIP-HKU/CBCT_projection.
The repository also contains a Python script to reconstruct the CBCT images using Reconstruction Toolkit… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hku-mip/cbct_projection.
